output.summary: A hardy deciduous tree found across Asia from eastern China and Korea to the Himalayas. It has glossy pointed leaves and clusters of small cream flowers. Its sweet, fragrant fleshy fruit stalk is edible raw or cooked and resembles raisins when dried.
output.edibilityNote: The fleshy fruit stalk is eaten raw or cooked; when dried, it looks and tastes like raisins.
